title.full: Using the NRIC after an overseas death

summary.text: If the death happened overseas, provide the deceased person's NRIC when reporting the death to ICA.

steps.name: Gather the NRIC
steps.text: Keep the deceased person's Singapore NRIC ready as an identification document for reporting an overseas death.

steps.name: Report the death
steps.text: Report the overseas death to ICA using FormSG.

example_phrasings: what do I do with the NRIC of someone who died
What should I do with a dead person's NRIC
How do I use the NRIC after someone dies

sources.page_title: What are the documents required for reporting overseas death?

quotes.text: Deceased's Singapore identification documents (NRIC, Singapore passport or Long Term Pass card)
You may report the death of your family member (Singapore resident or Long-Term Pass holder) who died overseas to ICA via FormSG.
